reason: Free and local is nice, but I'm not spending an afternoon recording flows and babysitting a sandbox explorer so an AI can tell me what my business rules are. We already have tests and code review for the PRs the agent writes.
objection: The model decides what the scenarios and rules are, so a field it never explored or a rule it misread just won't show up in the diff, and a clean report gives me false confidence.
would_change_my_mind: Running it on one of our real agent-written PRs and having it catch a regression our test suite missed, with a diff I can verify myself.
